name: framepacer
description: Universal Graphics API Display Frame Pacer & Jitter Eliminator

scripts.build:exe: npm run compile:cpp && npm run package
scripts.build:unpacked: node -e "const mod = require('png-to-ico'); const fn = mod.default || mod; const fs = require('fs'); fn('assets/framepacer-logo.png').then(buf => fs.writeFileSync('assets/icon.ico', buf));" && electron-packager . FramePacer --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.ico --extra-resource=bin

author: FramePacer Team
